head: How fast did employee and PAC gifts spread?
deck: Gifts to linked committees reached 10 of today’s members by the end of 2024 and 200 by Sept. 30, 2026.
note: Employees gave their own money. The PAC is Anthropic’s political action committee. Employer is as donors reported it to the FEC, including misspellings and replies in the occupation box. Amounts are before refunds.

head: Who did outside groups spend for and against?
deck: Committees that received network money reported $338M against Republicans out of $455M in spending from all donors on members serving on Nov. 26, 2026.
note: The filings identify the committee that spent the money. They cannot trace an expenditure to a donor.

head: What share did network clients report on federal AI filings?
deck: A comparison group of major tech and AI companies reported 6% of the dollars on 2025 filings naming any AI issue in this collection. The network share depends on which filings count.
note: When a client reported its own expenses for a quarter, its outside firms’ fees for that quarter were counted through those expenses.
bridge: Which bills came up most in Anthropic’s lobbying reports?
how: Each 2025 filing gives one amount covering all of its issues.

head: Which bills came up most in Anthropic’s lobbying reports?
deck: AI OVERWATCH Act led the stand-alone proposals, with 8 reports naming it.
note: The reports name bills and leave Anthropic’s position on them open.
bridge: How common were gifts to those bills’ sponsors?
how: A report can name several proposals. House and Senate versions count together when a filing names them as a pair.
source: Federal lobbying reports and saved Congress.gov bill records
